implementation_note: Nociceptor preserves the accepted high-threshold pain receptor and spike-triggered sensitisation model while replacing raw Euler membrane and sensitisation decay increments with exact closed-form first-order relaxation over each timestep. The Rust engine now rejects non-finite stimulus, non-finite state, nonphysical finite membrane voltage, invalid time constants, out-of-range sensitisation, negative gain or sensitisation-rate parameters, invalid threshold ordering, and candidate non-finite membrane or sensitisation states before mutation.
